import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_10.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_11.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_12.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_14.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_15.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/test_16.csv",
]

# Step 1: Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)  # ignore the first numerical index column
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['country', 'cpi'] and types are correct
    df = df[['country', 'cpi']].copy()
    df['country'] = df['country'].astype(str)
    df['cpi'] = df['cpi'].astype(float)
    dfs.append(df)

# Step 2: Since all source tables have the same schema as the target,
# we can concatenate (union) all rows from all sources.
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: The target examples show no aggregation or grouping is needed,
# so we keep all rows as is.

# Step 4: Export the combined DataFrame to the target CSV path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_6/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
